foods.name: Caspian Sea Almas Osetra Caviar
foods.description: Exceptionally rare, these large, strikingly light, bright eggs offer a unique tasting opportunity, as Almas is seldom available. Almas caviar presents a delicate palate with extremely elegant and mild flavor and subtle richness.

foods.name: Special Reserve® Kaluga Huso Hybrid
foods.description: Kaluga-Huso is a naturally-occurring hybrid combining the rich flavors of Beluga caviar with a clean, buttery burst, firm beads and a velvet finish. This decadent masterpiece is perfect for those who prefer butter to brine.

foods.name: Special Reserve® Ossetra Caviar
foods.description: Special Reserve® Ossetra represents the pinnacle of Ossetra caviar, selected from only the finest batches. It offers a rich, briny, and lingering flavor with a sublime symphony of taste and texture, ideal for true connoisseurs.

foods.name: Special Reserve® Alverta Caviar
foods.description: Special Reserve® Alverta is matured to perfection, offering a nutty flavor, soft lingering finish, and a rare touch of sweetness amid briny notes. Ideal for connoisseurs seeking a bold and unique caviar experience.

foods.name: Almas Albino Caviar
foods.description: Produced only by an extremely rare Albino Beluga Sturgeon, Almas is the ultimate and world’s highest value caviar. The name 'Almas' translates from Persian as 'Diamonds', referencing the appearance of the eggs. These Huso Huso Albino Sturgeon inhabit the southern Caspian Sea and are about 60 years old when harvested. Albino Almas caviar is extremely rare, sometimes only available every 5–10 years, and can command prices up to £40,000 per kilogram. Imperial Caviar ensures authenticity by never substituting inferior yellow caviar.

foods.name: Jamón Ibérico de Bellota Bone-In by 5J
foods.description: 5J (Cinco Jotas) Jamón Ibérico de Bellota is one of the world’s most exceptional and prestigious hams. Crafted exclusively from 100% purebred Ibérico pigs roaming the dehesas of Spain's Sierra de Aracena, these pigs feed on acorns and wild herbs during the Montanera season, resulting in signature marbling and the profound, complex flavors characteristic of true acorn-fed jamón ibérico. Each ham is hand-salted and slowly aged in historic cellars under the mastery of artisanal curing experts, culminating in a culinary work of art with layered notes of acorn, hazelnut, wildflowers, and a silky, umami-rich finish. A global icon of Spanish gastronomy.

foods.name: Prunier Osciètre Héritage
foods.description: An iconic and rare Osciètre caviar representing only 1 percent of Prunier’s annual production. Features slightly larger grains with a creamy texture that melts on the palate, offering delicate and complex flavors. Known for its golden brown color, the lightest in the Prunier Osciètre line. Produced from Acipenser gueldenstaedtii sturgeon, raised for over 12 years in France before harvesting.

foods.name: Takamori Drunken Wagyu A5 Whole Beef Ribeye
foods.description: Authentic A5 Takamori Wagyu whole ribeye imported from Yamaguchi Prefecture. Known as Drunken Wagyu because the cattle are fed Dassai sake mash, creating a mild and silky flavor profile. Includes Certificate of Authenticity and ships frozen in temperature controlled packaging.

foods.name: Caviar House Finest Caviar Beluga Vacuum Tin
foods.description: Beluga caviar sourced exclusively from the Huso Huso sturgeon. Known for its very large grains and pearl grey color, it offers a rich creamy texture, full-bodied taste, pronounced iodine character, and a long lingering finish. Considered one of the most exceptional and luxurious caviars available.

foods.name: Jamón Ibérico Bellota Whole Leg
foods.description: Montaraz's Jamón Ibérico de Bellota is a stunning centerpiece made from free-range 100% Ibérico pigs, exclusively fed on acorns and grass during the Montanera season. This age-old delicacy is cured using only salt and patience, resulting in decadently buttery and nutty flavors, beautifully marbled fat, and a unique melt-in-your-mouth texture. Crafted using traditional methods passed down for four generations, this jamón offers a truly luxurious gastronomic experience.
foods.condition: Whole leg, hoof removed for US import

foods.name: Takamori Drunken Wagyu A5 Whole Boneless Striploin
foods.description: Authentic A5 Takamori Wagyu whole boneless striploin imported from Yamaguchi Prefecture. Known as Drunken Wagyu because the cattle are fed Dassai sake mash which creates a mild and silky flavor profile. Includes a Certificate of Authenticity and ships frozen in temperature controlled packaging.

foods.name: Parmigiano Reggiano PDO Vacche Rosse 24 Months Whole Wheel
foods.description: An Italian delicacy made from the prized milk of Vacche Rosse Reggiane cows. Known for a sweet and persistent flavor, straw yellow color, rich aroma, and better digestibility compared to traditional Parmigiano Reggiano.

foods.name: Piedmont Alba White Truffles
foods.description: Sourced from the Piedmont region of Northern Italy by long-acquainted master truffle hunters and foragers, these aromatic tubers offer the uniquely deep truffle flavor long treasured by the world's finest chefs. *Approximated weight.

foods.name: Premium Caviar Assortment
foods.description: A curated trio of premium caviar varieties designed for side by side tasting. Includes one 1.75 oz Beluga Hybrid Caviar, one 1.75 oz Kaluga Osetra Caviar, and one 1.75 oz Karat Russian Osetra Caviar. Best enjoyed with champagne, white wine, or vodka and can be savored alone or used in special dishes.

foods.name: Prosciutto di Parma PDO 30 Months Whole With Bone In Wooden Box
foods.description: An Italian charcuterie masterpiece aged for 30 months in the hills of Parma. Presented whole with bone and housed in an elegant wooden box. Known for its sweet and natural flavor, achieved through a long artisanal aging process using only pork, salt, time, and the gentle winds of Parma.
foods.limitedEdition: La Cantina di Umberto e Rosa 1922

foods.name: Perigord Black Winter Truffles
foods.description: The finest and most concentrated of all the black truffles, often referred to as black diamonds, sourced from the dark rich soil of the renowned Perigord region of France. Known for fragrant aromatics and a rich yet sweet earthy flavor profile, perfect for Fall and Winter cookery. Available fresh from December to February while in season.

foods.name: Olympia Provisions Landrauchschinken
foods.description: Olympia Provisions Landrauchschinken is a traditional German-style smoked and dry-cured ham, crafted in Portland by Olympia Provisions. This artisan delicacy is slowly cured, gently smoked over apple and hickory wood, and aged to develop deep, smoky flavor and a tender, silky texture. Sliced paper thin, it’s perfect for charcuterie boards and gourmet sandwiches. A favorite among cured-meat connoisseurs.

foods.name: White Truffle Moliterno
foods.description: White Truffle Moliterno is a decadent Italian sheep’s milk cheese shot through with rich seams of earthy white truffle. The wheels are aged before being injected with black and white truffle paste, adding deep, savory, and garlicky notes to the nutty, crystalline Moliterno. Its striking marbling and bold aroma make it a luxurious centerpiece for cheese boards and truffle lovers alike.

foods.name: Tête de Moine Whole Wheel
foods.description: Tête de Moine is a semi-hard Swiss cheese made from raw cow's milk. Originally produced by monks of Bellelay Abbey in the Jura Mountains, it is mildly funky with light, fruity flavors. Traditionally served in delicate 'flowers' using a girolle, it pairs beautifully with fruity dessert wines.

foods.name: Olympia Provisions Mortadella
foods.description: Olympia Provisions Mortadella is an authentic Italian-style mortadella, slow-roasted and delicately seasoned. Crafted using traditional techniques, it features finely ground pork studded with rich cubes of creamy fat for a silky texture and irresistible flavor. Perfect for gourmet sandwiches, antipasto platters, or as a luxurious charcuterie addition.

foods.name: Truffle Brie
foods.description: Truffle Brie sets a decadent triple crème at the intersection of rich French cheese and earthy, aromatic truffles. Plush, creamy brie is split and layered with a lush truffle cream, making for an indulgent bite with deep, garlicky truffle notes and buttery undertones. A centerpiece-worthy addition to any cheese board and perfect for special occasions.

foods.name: Vacherin Mont d'Or
foods.description: Vacherin Mont d'Or is a legendary French raw cow's milk cheese prized for its luscious, gooey texture and unmistakable woodsy character. Ripened in a spruce bark belt, the cheese develops earthy, resinous notes and a rich, creamy mouthfeel. Traditionally served warm by oven baking in its wooden box, it's a winter delicacy that pairs beautifully with bread and white wine.

foods.name: San Giuliano Lemon Marmalade
foods.description: Hand-crafted in Sicily using estate-grown lemons from the San Giuliano estate, this marmalade is gently cooked to preserve the vibrant flavor and aroma of fresh lemons. Sweet and tart, it’s perfect for pairing with cheese, toast, pastries, or as a refined accent for desserts and breakfast spreads.
